Static firmware deep dive

Fujitsu iRMC S6 OEM-IPMI reachable paths

Firmware-bound to 02.63S. This report replaces parent multiplexers with unique reachable request constraints and retains non-LAN-proven LUN-3 identities. It does not equate a switch label with an independently usable operation unless the enclosing request path is proven.

Denominator proof

124 direct non-parameter identities + 228 existing selector/group paths + 40 F5/A4 paths + 50 E0/04 paths + 18 F5/07 flash paths + 44 F5/0B flash paths + 92 backup paths + 92 restore paths = 688.

This supersedes the 628 structural count by replacing two partially modeled flash parents with 62 exact child paths, a net increase of 60. The exact Fujitsu dual-image provider splits each former residual into its one-byte accepted request and exhaustive overlong rejection class.

Shared parameter engine, target overlays retained

The exact backup and restore wrappers plus their shared 92-record helper table now close the wire/helper control flow for all 184 route overlays. The two directions remain separate, and every row retains its own record type, sub-ID domain, restriction, privilege, effect and provider route.

19 paths are statically closed end to end: eleven reject or return before the provider, and eight IPv4 backup overlays are closed through the exact Fujitsu libfts_nvram provider. 165 provider boundaries remain unresolved, so their validation, redaction, persistence and activation are not promoted to known.

The exact XD670 image contains no libfts_nvram; none of this configuration-provider implementation is shared across targets. Wrapper corrections: restore lengths ≤7 return 0xc9; exactly 8 bytes return 0xff; a staged-buffer allocation failure can return raw 0x17. A helper restriction failure is mapped to wire completion 0xff.

AMI dual-image sharing boundary

The exact Fujitsu provider is libipmiamioemdualimg.so.13.1.0; XD670 uses libipmiamioemdualimg.so.13.6.0. Their whole binaries are different, so the report does not merge the implementations.

Only selectors 0x04, 0x07 are shared as field-proved provider/wire fragments: each requires a one-byte provider request and returns a one-byte body on success. Fujitsu's F5/07 routing, Administrator authorization, outer activation gate, IANA framing, and completion/body copy remain target-specific overlays.

Limits that remain explicit

  • Static analysis only in this pass; no system was contacted.
  • Path reachability does not prove backend availability or physical side effects.
  • Provider-specific parameter validation, redaction, persistence, and secret contents remain unresolved for 165 parameter overlays; eight read-only IPv4 backup overlays are closed through the exact configuration provider.
  • Only the selector-0x04 and selector-0x07 provider fragments are shared with XD670, based on field-for-field comparison. The different whole-provider binaries are not treated as interchangeable.
  • LUN-3 FRU identities are retained but prior LAN reachability was negative/unproven.

Analysis-boundary incident

A headless Ghidra -process -noanalysis invocation unexpectedly saved the existing zBMC-owned FTSUtil project before use of that project was stopped. No tracked source file changed and no rollback or deletion was attempted.

Recoverability: Unknown: pre-run hashes or a dedicated backup were not captured, so exact rollback cannot be proven. The three paths are ignored Ghidra project data, not tracked source.

  • /Volumes/xxx/src/me/git/zbmc/work/irmc-ipmi-analysis/ghidra-fts-util/FTSUtil.rep/idata/~index.dat
